normalization_plan.reason: owner_ exists only to seed the setOwner parameter and its value flows directly into the owner state variable
authority_ exists only as the setAuthority argument that writes the authority state variable
digest is a transient EIP712 hash computed only for the ecrecover check inside callProxy
_gasCost is only consumed by getFee to add the gas portion to the charged fee
local fee variable is only used to derive feeAmount within getFee
_amount is the callback flashloan amount used only inside executeOperation
swapAmount is an intermediate value used only during the flashloan executeOperation flow
